meta.description: Registry of official zoning data sources for each piloted jurisdiction.
meta.note: All sources must be official government or publicly authoritative. Commercial data and real-estate sites are not permitted here.

ordinance.title: Loudoun County Zoning Ordinance (rewrite effective 2023-12-13)
ordinance.notes: 2026-07-29 correction: the comprehensive zoning ordinance rewrite flagged as 'underway' in the previous version of this entry has completed — the Board of Supervisors adopted the rewritten Zoning Ordinance effective 2023-12-13, and it moved off Municode entirely onto this eCode+ platform. The old Municode URL (library.municode.com/va/loudoun_county/codes/codified_ordinances) no longer hosts the zoning ordinance; Municode's codified ordinances are a separate, non-zoning code. Data center use-specific standards are at section 4.06.02: https://online.encodeplus.com/regs/loudouncounty-va-zo/doc-viewer.aspx?secid=859

dcod_overlay.title: Data Center Standards & Locations — Loudoun County
dcod_overlay.notes: 2026-07-29 correction: this entry previously described a 'Data Center Overlay District (DCOD)' as the current mechanism, which does not match current sourcing. As of the Phase 1 Zoning Ordinance Amendment approved 2025-03-18, data center uses require Special Exception (SPEX) approval in the Industrial Park (IP), General Industry (GI), and Mineral Resources-Heavy Industry (MR-HI) districts (ordinance section 4.06.02) — not a named overlay district. Phase 2 (approved 2025-09-16) is an ongoing process through mid-2026 that may further change this; re-verify before citing specifics. The county also publishes an interactive map of existing/proposed data center parcels and substations, updated roughly every 6 months: https://experience.arcgis.com/experience/0c2021535c3f47589d1a10d6d0e2948c
